theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U₁ U₂ W : Set (Euclid P)) (T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U₁ n) (T₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U₂ n) (R₁ : IMRep U₁ n) (R₂ : IMRep U₂ n), IsOpen U₁ → IsOpen U₂ → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U₁ → W ⊆ U₂ → R₁.Represents T₁ → R₂.Represents T₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn W n, currentEval T₁ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = currentEval T₂ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) → R₁.measure.restrict W = R₂.measure.restrict W
